scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter client dev"
scripts.db:up: dotenv -- docker run --rm -it -v "%cd%:/work" -w /work -e DBMATE_MIGRATIONS_DIR=server/src/db/migrations -e DBMATE_SCHEMA_FILE=server/src/db/schema.sql -e DATABASE_URL ghcr.io/amacneil/dbmate:latest up
